content.text:
cd /workspace && git commit -m "chore: remove mock data from pipeline and enforce zero-tolerance policy
ROOT CAUSE:
- stockholm-venues source called generateStockholmSamples() which created 5 fake events
- These events appeared in database and UI as real stockholm.com events
- This violated EventPulse's requirement for real data only
ACTIONS TAKEN:
1. Replaced stockholm.ts with INACTIVE version (no mock data generation)
   - INACTIVE_SOURCE = true flag
   - Returns 'skipped' instead of generating fake events
   - Clear comments explaining why source is inactive
2. Removed stockholm-venues from sources list in index.ts
   - Commented out inactive source with explanation
   - Added ACTIVE/INACTIVE source documentation in comments
3. Removed stockholm-venues from App.js FALLBACK_PROVIDERS
   - Removed from provider dropdown (no longer selectable)
   - Removed from formatProviderLabel()
   - Removed from getCtaText()
4. Deleted mock events from Supabase database
   - 5 events with source='stockholm' removed
   - Database now contains only real event data
5. Added MOCK DATA PROHIBITION rule to API_METHOD_RULE.txt
   - Absolute rule: mock data is FORBIDDEN
   - Covers all components: fetch, queue, normalizer, DB, UI, docs
   - Documents what to do when source has no real data (mark INACTIVE)
   - History section documents this violation

VERIFICATION:
- generateStockholmSamples() no longer exists in active code
- stockholm source cannot generate fake events
- No mock events in Supabase
- UI no longer shows stockholm-venues filter
- Mock data prohibition is now documented rule
PERMANENT RULE:
If a source has no real data available:
1. Mark source as INACTIVE (return 'skipped')
2. Remove from sources list in index.ts
3. Remove from UI FALLBACK_PROVIDERS
4. Document why source is inactive
5. Keep placeholder code for future (NO sample events)"
